decided_by: Malcolm picked SKIN8-reclining-sweep-nbp_flash_02 from the skin-art round-3 batch for /pages/faq
note:
Header banner for /pages/faq. This FILLS AN EMPTY SLOT rather than replacing anything: the hero section existed with no image at all and `overlay_opacity: 100`, so the page has been rendering a solid black band with the heading on it.

SOURCE: brand-band skin-art round 3, SKIN8-reclining-sweep, Nano Banana Flash candidate 02. Class B, no product in frame. Same pose family as the /pages/skin-concerns header, which took nbp_pro_02 from the same slot — a different candidate, so the two pages share a register without repeating a picture.

CROPPED, NOT EXTENDED. The band measures 1920x440 live, needing 4.364:1, and the source is 2.357:1. 1236px of 2688 comes off, leaving 6336x1452 at 4.364:1 with nothing invented.

THE CROP OFFSET IS THE WHOLE DECISION HERE, because this frame has no dark zone and the heading is CENTRED. Measured across candidate bands, the text zone — middle 46% wide by middle 30% tall — reads 117.9 at the top of the frame and 120.4 in the middle, both far too bright to carry white type. At top=1224 it reads 54.7. The frame runs bright at the top-left and falls away to the bottom-right, so the bottom band is the only one where a centred heading has any ground at all.

OVERLAY 100 -> 25. At 100 the image is invisible, which is what the page does today. 25 matches the research pages and leaves the skin its warmth; 40 was tested and reads duller for no legibility gain the crop had not already won.

MOBILE: the phone band is 1.048:1. Six crops were measured and the centre — where the heading sits — ranged from 150.6 down to 49.0; the crop at left=3515 is the darkest by a wide margin and keeps the face and throat. It also gets a CENTRE-WEIGHTED scrim rather than an edge one, because the heading sits in the middle of the phone band: 5% at the frame edges rising to 42% at the centre. Heading zone goes from mean 54.8 / max 236 to 39.7 / 153, while the top of the crop stays at 96.3 and the bottom at 16.2 — the skin keeps its range instead of being flattened.

OPTIMISATION: capped at 3000 on the long edge, quality 95, 4:4:4, metadata stripped, and not compressed harder — the CDN re-encodes to WebP and a pre-compressed source hands it artefacts to reproduce.
